name: @hoardodile/desktop
description: Windows Electron shell around the hoardodile Fastify sidecar.
author: wooloo26

scripts.package: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node ../../scripts/verify-feed.mjs
scripts.package:publish: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --x64 --publish always && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node ../../scripts/verify-feed.mjs
